fields.name: Ikotun Market
fields.description: One of the largest markets in Alimosho, offering fresh produce, meats, and household items. Busy daily market with hundreds of vendors.
fields.address: Ikotun Road, opposite Ikotun Bus Stop, Alimosho, Lagos

fields.name: Egbeda Market
fields.description: Popular market serving Egbeda and surrounding areas. Known for fresh foodstuffs, vegetables, and affordable prices.
fields.address: Egbeda Road, by Eggua Bus Stop, Alimosho, Lagos

fields.name: Igando Market
fields.description: Vibrant market in Igando area. Features fresh produce, fish, meat, and general merchandise.
fields.address: Igando Road, opposite Igando Local Government, Alimosho, Lagos

fields.name: LASU Market
fields.location: LASU Main Road, Ojo, Alimosho LGA
fields.description: Market serving Lagos State University community. Affordable prices for students and residents.
fields.address: LASU Main Road, opposite LASU Main Gate, Ojo, Lagos

fields.name: Iyana Ipaja Market
fields.description: Major market at Iyana Ipaja bus stop. Busy trading center with all types of goods.
fields.address: Iyana Ipaja Bus Stop, Abeokuta Expressway, Alimosho, Lagos

fields.name: Shasha Market
fields.description: Community market in Shasha area. Known for fresh vegetables and local foodstuffs.
fields.address: Shasha Road, by Heritage Bank, Alimosho, Lagos

fields.name: Baruwa Market
fields.description: Growing market serving Baruwa and surrounding communities. Good for fresh produce and meats.
fields.address: Baruwa Road, opposite Baruwa Health Centre, Ipaja, Lagos

fields.name: Meiran Market
fields.description: Neighborhood market in Meiran area. Offers variety of food items and household goods.
fields.address: Meiran Road, by Meiran Bus Stop, Alimosho, Lagos

fields.name: Oke Odo Market
fields.description: Large market known for foodstuffs, textiles, and general merchandise. Popular among traders.
fields.address: Oke Odo Road, by Oke Odo Bus Stop, Alimosho, Lagos

fields.name: Alimosho Central Market
fields.description: Central market serving the entire Alimosho LGA. Comprehensive selection of goods from fresh produce to electronics.
fields.address: Alimosho Local Government Secretariat Road, Alimosho, Lagos
